name: Exa Snapshot
desc: Search the web as it looked on a date you choose.
desc_zh: 按你指定的日期检索当时的互联网内容
solves: Live search leaks the future into a backtest. Snapshot draws on 400 billion stored page versions and returns only what existed on or before the date you set.
solves_zh: 用实时检索做回测，等于把未来泄了进去。Snapshot 基于四千亿个已存页面版本，只返回你设定日期当天及之前存在的内容。
best_for: You are scoring an agent on a task whose answer was not public yet when it ran.
best_for_zh: 你在给一个智能体的表现打分，而任务的答案在它运行时还未公开。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://exa.ai/blog and https://exa.ai/docs/changelog , then https://exa.ai/）。 Launched 2026-09-17 as a research preview. The docs describe it as returning 'results from the web as it was at a datetime you choose, drawn from stored page versions spanning two decades', set through contents.snapshotAsOf on /search and snapshotAsOf on /contents. Missing from the ledger, which holds only the Exa search API for this vendor. No media source was read. 首次公开日期来源：https://exa.ai/blog/exa-snapshot
